keywords: Elements & Periodic Table 2.Atoms & Molecules Structure of Atom 3.Combustion Theory 4.Ammonia Synthesis 5.Organic Compound
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn the science history and the chemical foundations necessary for science and engineering. (2) learn how to apply attitude and chemistry knowledge to science and engineering. (3) establish a style of study using a preview and review approach. (4) develop an autonomous and consecutive self-directed study ability.
advice: This is a course in chemical foundations. We will cover the following: 1. Periodic Table of Elements. 2.Theory of Atoms and Molecules, Atomic Structure, 3. Combustion of Substances. 4. Haber-Bosch process, Rate of chemical reactions. Chemical Equilibrium. 5.Organic chemistry (Functional Group, Isomer). (1) The class will be conducted following this syllabus. (2) Students are expected to do the homework, previews, and reviews for every class. (3) Students are expected to ask the teacher questions and use the Math. and Science Education Research Center. (4) Students are expected not to be late, as the accumulation of learning is important. (5) Students are expected to approach exams and quizzes with sufficient preparation. ※ Some details of the course may be changed as the course progresses.
books: Textbooks:Isaac Asimov “A Short History of Chemistry” (Doubleday and Co. Inc. New York) Reference books:Trevor H. Levere “A History of Chemistry from Alchemy to the Buckyball” (The John Hopkins Univ.Press) William H. Brock “The Fontana History of Chemistry” (Fontana Press)
requiredKnowledge: (1) Students prefer to study chemistry in high school prefer. However, students will need to work hard in the course and make sufficient effort to master. (2) Students are expected to read the textbook, complete the homework, and engage in the previews and reviews.

activityGoals.body: Understand the theory of atoms and molecules, the periodic law of elements, and explain them.
Understand the basic laws of chemistry and the theory of the combustion of substances, and explain them.
Understand the research history on the structure of the atom, and explain it.
Understand the rate of chemical reaction and chemical equilibrium through the study of the Haber-Bosch process.
Understand the basic matters(functional group etc.)through the research history on organic chemistry and explain

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Understand the periodic law of elements and precisely show the information on the periodic table of elements. (2) Precisely explain the stream of the theory from atoms to molecules. (3) Understand and precisely explain the structure of atoms through the research history on it. (4) Precisely explain the theory of combustion of substances and the basic laws of chemistry. (5) Understand and precisely explain the Haber-Bosch process and chemical equilibrium. (6) Precisely understand the functional group and isomers, the items of organic chemistry.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Generally, understand the periodic law of elements and show the information on the periodic table of elements. (2) Generally, explain the stream of the theory from atoms to molecules. (3) Understand and generally explain the structure of atoms through the research history on it. (4) Generally, explain the theory of combustion of substances and the basic laws of chemistry. (5) Understand and generally explain the Haber-Bosch process and chemical equilibrium. (6) Generally, understand the functional group and isomers, the items of organic chemistry.
